# Reading Ītzpāpālōtl through the work it rules today
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Ītzpāpālōtl** never stopped working.

Itzpapālōtl belongs to the dangerous borderlands: between paradise and underworld, birth and death, daylight and eclipse. Her myths are preserved in fragments of the Florentine Codex and Borgia group codices.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ītzpāpālōtl
- **Pantheon:** Nahuatl
- **Domain of influence:** Obsidian Butterfly, Stars
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Home & Lifestyle · Health & Wellbeing · Society & Spirit · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Gems, Jewelry & Luxury Materials
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 120 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Lady of Tamoanchan.** Tamoanchan is the mythical paradise of origins, a lush mountain of flowers and fruit where the creator couple dwelt.  Itzpapālōtl rules there as both guardian and destroyer, her obsidian wings protecting the tree from which the first humans were fashioned. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Cihuateteo.** Women who died in childbirth were not ordinary dead.  They became Cihuateteo, 'divine women', fierce spirits who accompanied the sun from zenith to sunset and prowled crossroads at night. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Gems, Jewelry & Luxury Materials

*Diamonds, gemstones, and precious materials. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The obsidian butterfly; volcanic glass as sacred material.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Women's Health & Femtech

*Women's health, wellness, and femtech platforms. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*Mother and queen of the Cihuateteo — women who died in childbirth and became powers; the mortal risk of maternity is her entire cult.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ītzpāpālōtl performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *A Tzitzimitl whose descent at eclipse was the most dreaded portent in the Mesoamerican sky; the dark half of astrology is her office.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science

*Space agencies, astronomy, and the orbital economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The obsidian butterfly associated with the stars of Tzitzimīmē.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Itzpapālōtl belongs to the dangerous borderlands: between paradise and underworld, birth and death, daylight and eclipse. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in gems, jewelry & luxury materials, women's health & femtech, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/itzpapalotl/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
